abstract: We report an unusual case of a 23 year old female who presented with symptoms of spinal cord compression by an extradural metastasis from a gestational choriocarcinoma. She gave the history of evacuation of a hydatidiform mole five months prior to presentation, following which she had been totally asymptomatic and had not attended any follow-up. She responded to conventional chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 23歳女性の症例を報告する。妊娠性絨毛癌からの硬膜外転移による脊髄圧迫症状を呈した。発症の5か月前に胞状奇胎の除去を受けていたが、その後は無症状であり、フォローアップを受けていなかった。従来の化学療法に反応した。
